Every loan, every fee and every kwacha accounted for.

The internal portal for Golden Financial Services — applications, disbursements, repayments, penalties, receipts and the audit trail behind each one.

  • Role-based access. Staff see the modules their role allows, customers see only their own record.
  • A receipt for every payment. Numbered, printable and matched to the allocation behind it.
  • Nothing edited silently. Every change carries the user, the time and the value it replaced.
Prototype build · sample data throughout
